experience.title: Data Analyst
experience.company: StoryAI — Dr. Ariel Han Research Lab
bullets: Coded 60+ hours of session video from 30 students across 3 age groups (ages 5–13) into a structured behavioral dataset, owning the majority of the coding pass on a 5-person research team
Built Tableau dashboards for the study, visualizing how student time distributed across planning, translating, and revising stages of the writing process
Measured a 30% decrease in passive writing planning from the coded video data, alongside self-reported pre/post gains of 52% in planning efficacy and ~40% in translation and revising efficacy
Wrangled and labeled raw session data in Google Sheets and Python; the resulting analysis supported a StoryAI demo to ~100 educators at the Anaheim Union High School District AI Summit

experience.title: Web Development Intern

Designed and independently ran user testing with 10 students and teachers across a 3-month build cycle
Found that assisted drafts showed greater lexical diversity and stronger idea generation than unassisted drafts, and reported the result together with its small-sample limitation

projects.name: Floor Generals: NBA Passing Network Analysis
bullets: Built an idempotent, restartable ingestion pipeline over the NBA Stats API using exponential backoff, atomic writes, and a resumable cache, collecting 9,461 directed passer–receiver edges across all 30 teams

Tested whether passing-network centralization predicts team standing with a 10,000-iteration permutation test on Spearman rank correlation (p = 0.269, n = 29), reporting the result as underpowered rather than as evidence of no effect
Produced an interactive tool that recomputes a team's passing graph with any player removed, quantifying how much shot creation depends on a single distributor

projects.name: League of Legends Esports: Action and Win Prediction
bullets: Analyzed 150,348 rows of professional match data across 10 tier-one leagues, testing cross-league differences in game pace with a 10,000-shuffle permutation ANOVA (F = 122.6, p < 0.001)

Predicted match outcome from 15-minute game state; a logistic baseline reached 76.1% test accuracy and a tuned Random Forest 76.6%, indicating early gold lead already captured nearly all available signal

Prevented leakage from mirrored team rows by splitting train and test on game ID and using GroupKFold for hyperparameter search; fairness analysis found a 5.5-point accuracy gap between major and regional leagues (p = 0.015)

projects.name: US Interstate Wage Gaps, 2004–2024
bullets: Built parallel state and county panels from BLS QCEW data — 1,050 state-years and 64,497 county-years across 3,107 counties — deflated to 2024 dollars using CPI-U

Found P90/P10 wage dispersion essentially flat at both scales (1.42 → 1.41 states; 1.61 → 1.57 counties) despite county real wage growth ranging from −34% to +161%, driven by shale-boom churn rather than coastal divergence
Validated the finding across four robustness specifications: COVID-year exclusion, DC sensitivity, and trimming the fastest- and slowest-growth states and counties
